profile.headline: Salesforce Software Engineer
profile.summary:
One of my greatest passions is to learn. I love to understand new things and to experiment with tools I haven't worked with in the past. Every new project has been an entire learning experience and I appreciate that!!

Music is a great part of my life and although I don't perform much I still look for opportunities to keep myself active in the music world!

positions.title: Salesforce Consultant
positions.description: Developer, Admin, Tester. Javascript, VisualForce, Apex classes, Triggers, Test Classes, flows, process builder, Data Loading, integration and configuration.

positions.title: Music Instructor - Music Academy
positions.description: Voice, Piano and Flute private and group instruction. Summer camps and experience as piano accompanist

company.name: The University of Texas Rio Grande Valley

positions.title: Assistant choir director
positions.description: Certified Middle School Teacher. Choir Director in charge of teaching the 6th Grade Choirs and Treble Choirs. Support for the A Cappella Choirs and the Tenor/Bass Choirs. Budgets, field trips, contests, private lessons, organization of multiple concerts, testing, and many other things that teachers understand...
